content_sections.heading: NEEPCO Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The important dates for NEEPCO JE Recruitment 2026 are given below: The online application portal will remain active from 00:01 Hrs on 11 August 2026 to 23:59 Hrs on 31 August 2026 .

content_sections.heading: NEEPCO Junior Engineer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: NEEPCO has announced a total of 7 Junior Engineer vacancies in Electrical and Mechanical disciplines. The vacancies are available at Agartala Gas Based Power Station and Tripura Gas Based Power Station.

content_sections.heading: NEEPCO Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for NEEPCO Junior Engineer posts must fulfil the educational qualification, age limit and other eligibility conditions mentioned in the official notification. The recruitment is open for candidates registered in Agartala Employment Exchange or Sepahijala Employment Exchange who possess Tripura state domicile. Candidates must have a Full Time Regular Diploma in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engineering. The qualification should be from a State Technical Board or recognized institute. For UR candidates, minimum 70% marks are required. SC/ST candidates should have pass marks in the prescribed qualification. Candidates must have a Full Time Regular Diploma in Mechanical / Production Engineering. The qualification should be from a State Technical Board or recognized institute. For UR/EWS candidates, minimum 70% marks are required. ST candidates should have pass marks in the prescribed qualification.

content_sections.heading: NEEPCO Junior Engineer Educational Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: Important Note: The course must be approved by BTE/State Technical Education Board. Diploma courses through Distance Learning Mode are not eligible.

content_sections.heading: NEEPCO Junior Engineer Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for NEEPCO Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 will be calculated as on 01 January 2026 . Ex-Serviceman candidates will receive an additional 10 years relaxation over the applicable upper age limit as per the notification.

content_sections.heading: NEEPCO Junior Engineer Salary Structure 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for the NEEPCO Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 will undergo training for a period of 2 years at identified NEEPCO sites. After selection, candidates will be placed in the IDA pay scale applicable to S-1 Grade. The compensation package includes Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA) where applicable, Cafeteria allowance, Location Based Allowance (LBA), Provident Fund contribution, NEDCSS benefits and other benefits as per company rules. Other benefits mentioned in the notification include: Leave benefits Medical benefits for self, spouse, two children and dependent parents Performance Related Pay (PRP) Gratuity as applicable Uniform allowance Communication expenses Furniture reimbursement as applicable

content_sections.heading: NEEPCO Junior Engineer Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: There is no application fee required for NEEPCO Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026. According to the official notification, no application fee is required from candidates applying for these posts.

content_sections.heading: NEEPCO Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for NEEPCO Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 consists of a written test. Eligible candidates will have to appear for the examination conducted by NEEPCO. The selection process includes: Aptitude Test Technical Test Merit-based appointment No skill test will be conducted for these posts.

content_sections.heading: NEEPCO JE Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The written examination will consist of two parts: Aptitude Test and Technical Test. The Aptitude Test will cover General English, Quantitative Aptitude and Reasoning. The test will be qualifying in nature. Each question carries 1 mark. There will be a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every wrong answer. Qualifying marks: UR/EWS: 40% SC/ST: 30% The Technical Test will contain questions related to the respective engineering discipline. The test will consist of 40 multiple choice questions. Each question carries 1 mark. Negative marking of 0.25 marks will apply for every wrong answer. Qualifying marks: UR/EWS: 40% SC/ST: 30%

content_sections.heading: NEEPCO Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready while applying and appearing for the selection process: Valid email ID Educational qualification certificate Diploma mark sheets and certificates Valid SC/ST/EWS certificate, if applicable Tripura domicile certificate Employment Exchange registration details Identity proof Other documents mentioned in the recruitment process Candidates appearing for the written test must submit valid essential qualification certificates and category certificates wherever applicable.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for NEEPCO Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official NEEPCO recruitment portal. No other mode of application will be accepted. Visit the official NEEPCO website. Go to the Careers section. Read the Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 notification carefully. Check eligibility criteria before applying. Open the online application link. Register using a valid email ID. Fill in the required personal and educational details. Upload the required documents. Submit the application form before the last date. Save or print the submitted application for future reference. The online application portal will remain active from 00:01 Hrs on 11 August 2026 to 23:59 Hrs on 31 August 2026 .

content_sections.heading: NEEPCO Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals above 18 years are eligible to apply. Candidates must ensure that they fulfil all eligibility conditions before submitting the application. All qualifications must be obtained from institutions recognised by BTE, AICTE or appropriate statutory authorities. No manual or paper applications will be accepted. TA/DA will be paid to candidates appearing for the written test. Admit cards will be available through the recruitment portal and will not be sent by post. Candidates must keep their registered email ID active for at least one year. The upper age limit will be calculated as on 01 January 2026. SC/ST/EWS candidates must submit valid certificates in the prescribed Government of India format. EWS candidates must submit the current year Income and Asset Certificate valid for FY 2026-27. Incorrect information or submission of false documents may lead to cancellation of candidature. Government/Public Sector employees must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of written test.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are released under NEEPCO Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NEEPCO has announced a total of 7 Junior Engineer vacancies in Electrical and Mechanical disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in NEEPCO JE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Junior Engineer (Electrical) and Junior Engineer (Mechanical) in S-1 Grade.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for NEEPCO Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a Full Time Regular Diploma in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics Engineering for JE Electrical and Diploma in Mechanical/Production Engineering for JE Mechanical.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NEEPCO JE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years for UR/EWS candidates and 35 years for SC/ST candidates as on 01 January 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of NEEPCO Junior Engineer?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive an IDA pay scale of ₹29,300 - 3% - ₹1,19,700. The minimum monthly CTC is approximately ₹59,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for NEEPCO Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a written test consisting of an Aptitude Test and Technical Test.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for NEEPCO JE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. There is no application fee required for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to apply for NEEPCO Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 31 August 2026.
